evidence.text:
SAV: RICE HOPE NEW AUTO TRANSFORMER
Teams # 20989
Need Date 06/01/2029 Start Date 06/01/2025
Install a new 230/115kV 400MVA auto transformer at Rice Hope and loop in the Crossgate - McIntosh 230kV line.

uncertainties: Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidential notices, and all cost information is redacted.
Work involves specific segments between Four Mile tap - Recovery - Sinai (FPL) on the Sinai (FPL) - South Bainbridge line, split across FPL and GPC territories.

evidence.text:
SOUTH BAINBRIDGE - SINAI (FPL) 115KV LINE RECONDUCTOR
Teams # 13628
Need Date 06/01/2029 Start Date 06/01/2025
Rebuild the Four Mile tap - Recovery - Sinai (FPL) segment of the Sinai (FPL) - South Bainbridge 115kV line from 100C 336.4 ACSR to 200C 1351 ACSS. 9.8 miles in FPL and 13.75 miles in GPC

uncertainties: Document contains Critical Energy Infrastructure Information (CEII) and confidential notices, and all cost information is redacted.
The start date is listed as 06/01/2031 which is chronologically after the need date of 12/31/2029.

evidence.text:
BAY CREEK - CONYERS 230KV REBUILD
Teams # 20248
Need Date 12/31/2029 Start Date 06/01/2031
GPC will rebuild the Bay Creek - Conyers 230kV line, approximately 15.29 miles, using 200C 1351 ACSS "Martin" conductor.
